newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges lower, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges lower, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down 0.05 percent in higher trade boosted by over-the-counter exchanges, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 486.83 points, down from 487.08 on Friday.
Total volume was 3.84 million dinars against 711,754 dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 3.33 million dinars.

Detergent firm SPCD gained one dinar to 35.5 dinars with only 90 shares changing hands. Insurance firm Compagnie d'Assurances et de Reassurance ASTREE was up 0.72 dinar to 24.78. Palm Beach Hotels rose 0.2 dinar to 11 dinars.

Banque de Tunisie fell 1.4 dinar to 76.6 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie slid 0.84 dinar to 33. UBCI bank was down 0.78 dinar to 47.1 dinars. Societe Tunisienne de Banque declined 0.51 dinar to 16.48.

Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF eased 0.66 dinar to 16.82 dinars. Drinks bottler SFBT edged lower 0.26 dinar to 89. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel declined 0.25 dinar to 11.5 dinars. Airline Tunis Air was down 0.2 dinars with the exchange of 5,010 shares.
